list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades cross-checked against the Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists, 18 November 2026). Guides below are written in our own words; each trophy names its sources.

notes.difficulty: PowerPyx rates the Platinum 4/10, about 200 hours.
notes.cheats: Using cheats is reported to switch off trophies and saving for that session (PowerPyx, GTABase). Keep cheats off your trophy save.
notes.saves: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one from just before the final mission (Output Lag).
notes.hidden: 28 of the 55 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in order, finish the story, then clear the 100% checklist and the cleanup trophies. PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours in total, and rates the set 4/10 — long rather than hard, with no online trophies and no mission medals to chase.
steps: Finish the five story chapters.
Complete the 100% checklist (A Long Road).
Clean up the remaining activity, collectible and miscellaneous trophies.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the game, so this pops the first time you play through it. Nothing to prepare and nothing you can skip past — just follow the mission prompts until it ends.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. One thing to do inside this chapter before it ends: Lucia's balcony meditation, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 is over. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter so you can go back if you miss it.
steps: In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends.
Play through the rest of Chapter 1; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Chapter 2 is where most of the list opens up: switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks after the Breakfast Run mission, and with both characters playable you can start partner activities, garage purchases and Scooter Bros registrations. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals as you travel, since that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.
steps: Play through Chapter 2; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.
After Breakfast Run, use the newly unlocked character switching to start partner and free-roam trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Two time-sensitive things live in this chapter: the race against Yago in his street-racing strand, which is marked with an hourglass and counts toward Strangers & Freaks, and the Snap Gun jewelry-store robberies that unlock through the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Do the Yago race the moment it appears, and keep a save from the start of the chapter.
steps: Do the Race Against Yago as soon as it appears in Chapter 3.
Play through the rest of Chapter 3; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Late in this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens up bank-vault robberies, which Maximum Withdrawal needs — take that mission when it appears rather than leaving it for later. Before the chapter ends, make an untouched manual save: the final mission follows in Chapter 5 and there is no mission replay.
steps: Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it appears, to unlock bank vaults.
Make a manual save before the chapter ends.
Play through the rest of Chapter 4; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable gold trophy for completing the final mission of the story. Before you start it, keep an untouched manual save from just before the mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back to the pre-finale state. After the credits you return to free-roam Leonida, where everything needed for the 100% checklist is still available.
steps: Make an untouched manual save just before the final mission.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops with the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run, early in Chapter 2. It matters beyond itself: finishing this mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which most partner trophies depend on. Just play the mission through.
steps: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends; no preparation is needed and it cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main story.
steps: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends; no preparation is needed and it cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main story.
steps: Complete the mission Child's Play.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends; no preparation is needed and it cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main story.
steps: Complete the mission Headliners.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends; no preparation is needed and it cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main story. The mission's airport setting is a good preview of Catch Me If You Can, which needs a jet taken from a VCIA boarding bridge in free roam.
steps: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends; no preparation is needed and it cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main story.
steps: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list, and the last one most players earn. The 100% checklist has 35 requirements and only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but anything you do before the credits already counts. The thresholds are lenient: PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% true completion. You need 200 of 277 vehicle models scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets and 15 of 18 meditation spots — but a few items need everything, including all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 14 drone-race wins and Bret's full questline. Nothing on the checklist is missable: it can all be finished in free roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the 35 requirements in any order; most overlap with other trophies.
Prioritise the full-completion items: 8 vaults, 39 illegal operations, 42 range golds, 14 drone wins, Bret's quests.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. Stunts come in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Any mix counts, so chase the easy ones first — jumps and under-bridge flights — and leave the trickier knife flights for later. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping here.
steps: Do stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — any 250 count.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The count comes from the trophy's own progress tracker: try a bit of everything the game offers — fishing, racing, shooting-range challenges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and gym training are the kinds of activities that count — and the trophy pops once all 9 types have been tried. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample each one.
steps: Sample each activity type once: fishing, a race, the shooting range, a drone race, an arcade game, bowling, meditation, hunting and gym training.
Check the trophy's progress counter to see which type is still missing.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two shooting ranges. The challenges are scored on accuracy and speed, so use a weapon you control well and take the stationary targets first to learn the scoring. The 100% checklist also needs all 42 golds, so this trophy and that checklist item are the same piece of work.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges and work through their challenges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. You only need one win per location, so a single victory at each spot is enough — you do not need to win every race a location offers. The 100% checklist also needs all 14 wins, so this trophy and that checklist item are the same piece of work. Learn each course's racing line with a practice run before going for the win.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone-race locations.
Win at least one race at every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins in the same one. Street races, off-road races and other race types all count toward the total. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 different race wins, so keep racing past 20. Pick short, easy courses first and work through the race list systematically.
steps: Win races across the different race types and locations.
Reach 20 different race wins; keep going to 30 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet while fishing in Leonida; take his challenge and out-fish him. If you lose, you can try the challenge again — there is no reported limit on attempts. Do this early, while you are already fishing in Chapter 1, so it is done before the story moves on.
steps: Go fishing and find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge; retry if you lose.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four in-game arcade games, and finishing any single one is enough — pick the one you find easiest and play it to completion. Arcade cabinets are found in arcades and bars around Leonida; this also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in an arcade or bar.
Play any one of the four arcade games through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's questline. Andy is one of the side characters with a multi-mission strand; his missions are Lucia-only. The strand stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — just work through Andy's missions in order until the finale. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
steps: Play as Lucia and work through Andy's missions in order.
Complete Andy's final mission.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's questline. Kenton is one of the side characters with a multi-mission strand; work through his missions in order until the finale. The strand stays available after the credits, so it can be finished during cleanup if you prefer.
steps: Work through Kenton's missions in order.
Complete Kenton's final mission.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's questline. Billy is one of the side characters with a multi-mission strand; work through his missions in order until the finale. The strand stays available after the credits. Note that Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
steps: Work through Billy's missions in order.
Complete Billy's final mission.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not, because each has its own trophy, so do not rely on those three. The time-sensitive one is the Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 — it is marked with an hourglass, so do it the moment it appears and save first. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones counted.
steps: Do the Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears (time-sensitive).
Finish 8 stranger strands that count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not.
Check the trophy counter after each strand to confirm it counted.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's questline. Randy is one of the side characters with a multi-mission strand; work through his missions in order until the finale. The strand stays available after the credits, so it can be finished during cleanup if you prefer.
steps: Work through Randy's missions in order.
Complete Randy's final mission.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's questline. Tyrone is one of the side characters with a multi-mission strand, and his missions are Jason-only; work through them in order until the finale. The strand stays available after the credits. Note that Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
steps: Play as Jason and work through Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.

sources.name: Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable — the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable. Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and it may count toward the total. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, per GTABase. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The one spot you can lose: in Chapter 1, after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time) — she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Note: the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is the stricter one.
steps: Chapter 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends.
Meditate at every spot (18 spots, 10 locations), bringing your partner so each outdoor spot counts for both characters.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — work through his hunts until one asks for a unique animal. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants. Bret's full questline is also one of the items the 100% checklist needs in full, so finishing it serves both trophies.
steps: Play as Jason and start Bret's hunting questline.
Work through his target decks until a unique animal hunt appears.
Take the unique animal with a clean head or heart shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; each set is a group of cards, and finishing any 3 sets earns the trophy. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3 — you will need most of the cards anyway. Pick up cards whenever you pass one rather than leaving them all for a dedicated sweep.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida and complete any 3 sets.
Keep collecting toward 15 of 18 sets for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone app for scanning and tagging places; open it at landmarks and points of interest around Leonida and tag each one. The 100% checklist also needs 100 locations, so this trophy and that checklist item are the same piece of work. Fold it into normal travel: tag places as you pass them instead of making a separate trip.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at landmarks and points of interest.
Tag 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play — driving, shooting, exploring and side activities all feed them. You only need 50 of 80, so skip the ones that look miserable. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep going past 50 and pick the next-easiest challenges from the list.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and work through the easiest ones.
Complete 50 challenges; keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. The easiest way is during a bank-vault robbery: vault jobs hand you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time as Maximum Withdrawal. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — keep driving until the heat fully clears. Partner switching unlocks after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
steps: Bring your partner along (switching unlocks after Breakfast Run).
Get a 4-star Wanted Level — a bank-vault robbery does this automatically.
Escape until you are fully out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep moving fast between shops and do not stop to hide. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
steps: Call your partner to join you.
Rob three shops in a row while the Wanted Level stays active.
Wait a moment after the third shop — the pop can be delayed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — point the app at cars, bikes, trucks and anything else on the road. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100; rare and mission-only vehicles are the ones to chase later.
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive.
Discover 100 vehicles; keep going to 200 base models for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 together while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so you can drop several targets before Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if you have it. Save first, since a failed attempt just means trying again.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation.
Aim, press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus, and drop 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane from Vice City International Airport and take off with it. Only planes docked at a boarding bridge count — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed, so fly about 1 km away from the airport before expecting it to pop. Save first, because the police come fast.
steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Board it, back out to the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy pops after a delay.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks are reported to be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. Expect heavy police attention once you are in it, so do not plan a long joyride.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, far southwest of the map.
Find a Rhino tank parked on the south side and get in.
Drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry-store robberies — go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it. Kicking the door in sets off the alarm, so do not do that. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door — do not kick it in.
Find the safe-code note, open the safe, and leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep robbing past 5.
steps: Complete That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock vaults.
Bring your partner, tail a security van to a large bank, and get into the vault.
Rob and escape 5 vaults; keep going to 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida with a security escort; ambush one, break into the back and grab the cash, then lose the police. A quiet road and a fast getaway car help — do not try it in the middle of Vice City traffic. The trophy pops once you have escaped, not when you open the truck.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and ambush it.
Break in, take the cash, and escape the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the map. The game tracks which areas you have visited, so the work is mostly done by playing: drive, fly and boat through every region, including the outlying islands and the far southwest. Check the map for greyed-out or unvisited areas and make a point of passing through each one. This pairs naturally with scanning vehicles, tagging WAiNK locations and finding meditation spots.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida, including the outlying islands.
Check the map for areas you have not visited and pass through each of the 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are marked gang hideouts and businesses you can raid for cash and loot; each gang needs one robbery to count. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so keep raiding past the first 9 — the trophy pops along the way. Operations you leave unfinished come back later, so a botched raid is not a lost chance.
steps: Find illegal operations around Leonida and raid one per gang.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch. The description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The likely trigger is ordering a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and drinking it while looking out over the water — but no guide has confirmed the exact spot or action yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach; if it does not pop, it may need a specific bar or a story moment. Do not treat any single bar as confirmed until a guide verifies it.
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail.
Drink it with the ocean view; if nothing pops, try other Ocean Beach bars.
Method unconfirmed — check back as guides verify it.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)
Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch. The description points to smashing a vehicle out through a showroom's front — the classic GTA move of driving a car through the glass — but no guide has confirmed which showroom, which vehicle or the exact trigger yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. The sensible attempt is to take a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the front window. If it does not pop, it may need a specific showroom or a story moment.
steps: Take a vehicle inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the front.
Method unconfirmed — check back as guides verify it.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)
Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
steps: In Chapter 2, go to Kingpin Bowling (the Kolt & Associates alley) with Sticky Bombs.
Take the luxury watch, the shotgun and the office safe's contents.
Escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you — the trophy should pop once both characters hit maximum Strength. Bench-pressing and other strength exercises at the gym build the attribute; train regularly between missions rather than leaving it all for the end.
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train Strength with your partner at the gym until both characters reach maximum.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase reports the count as 500 profile-changing actions; robberies, fights and other criminal acts feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind if you play the game the way the trophies ask — robberies, illegal operations and vaults all contribute. Check the Criminal Profile in the game to see your progress.
steps: Play normally: robberies, fights and illegal operations feed the count.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions; check the Criminal Profile for progress.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, likely a hidden second-chance event, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. It may pop naturally while you play, for example by retrying and then passing something you first failed. Do not chase it specifically until a guide verifies the method.
steps: Play normally; this may pop on a second attempt at something you first failed.
Method unconfirmed — check back as guides verify it.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)
Official description (PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch. The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points to witnessing something strange, most likely a hidden encounter or easter egg somewhere in Leonida, but no guide has confirmed what it is or where it happens yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Explore odd locations and follow up on strange sights; it may pop from an encounter you stumble into rather than one you can plan for.
steps: Explore Leonida and investigate strange encounters when you find them.
Method unconfirmed — check back as guides verify it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch. The description — a melee drive-by — means knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but no guide has confirmed the exact target, vehicle or location yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. The sensible attempt is a drive-by melee swing from a slow-moving car at a pedestrian; if it does not pop, it may need a specific setup. Do not treat any one method as confirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them, and the $250,000 total is cumulative across all sales. Bank vaults and payday-loan robberies are the main source, so this fills up naturally while you work on Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist's robbery requirements.
steps: Rob banks and payday-loan stores to collect Marked Bills.
Sell the bills to your contacts until $250,000 has been laundered in total.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothing, weapons, food, vehicle mods and everything else counts. You will spend a good chunk of it naturally on guns, ammo and clothes; if you are short near the end, buy expensive items you actually want (weapons and vehicle upgrades are the fastest way to close the gap) rather than wasting money on throwaway purchases.
steps: Spend money in any shops; the $100,000 total is cumulative.
Top it up late with weapons or vehicle upgrades if you are short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only purchased ones. Buy them as soon as you can afford them, since garage space is also needed to register vehicles for On the Spot.
steps: Complete Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garage properties (about $160,000 in total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap cars you do not mind keeping.
steps: Complete Moses in Chapter 2 to open the Scooter Bros app.
Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register — 10 times.
From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray trackers also work; keep a free garage space per car.

roadmap.title: Before you start
items: Turn the spoiler setting on in this tracker if you want story trophies hidden until you earn them.
Keep cheats off your trophy save — they are reported to switch off trophies and saving.
Plan your saves: 15 manual slots plus one autosave. Keep one at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — the one missable
items: Play Gone Fishing (Just Like Paradise).
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge (Baited My Tackle) and finish an arcade game (Stick Fiddler) while you are here.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is the only trophy reported as possibly missable. Keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.
Finish the chapter (Paradise Lost).

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 — Leonida opens up
items: Complete Breakfast Run (Trust) to unlock switching between Jason and Lucia.
Rob Kingpin Bowling with Sticky Bombs (Let's Go Bowling) and take all three valuables.
Buy garages in the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver (Little Boxes) and register cars in the Scooter Bros app after Moses (On the Spot).
Scan vehicles with WAiNK (Whip It Good) and study animals as you travel — both count toward the 100% checklist.
Start the side-character strands for Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason-only).
Finish the chapter (T**s Ass Drug Money).

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 — robberies begin
items: Do the Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive and counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun, then rob a jewelry store unseen (Sneakthief).
With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level (Retail Therapy).
Win drone races (Top Fun), races (Earn Cash, Not Kudos) and start the shooting-range golds (The Shootist).
Finish the chapter (Vice City, Baby!).

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 — vaults and gangs
items: Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank-vault robberies.
Rob 5 vaults with your partner (Maximum Withdrawal) — escaping one with a 4-star Wanted Level also earns Hot Together.
Rob an armored truck (A Classic Blitz Play) and one illegal operation per gang (Pest Control).
Launder Marked Bills through your contacts toward $250,000 (Dime on the Dollar).
Make an untouched manual save before the chapter ends.
Finish the chapter (Top Of The World, Ma).

roadmap.title: Chapter 5 — the finale
items: Check your saves: one untouched manual save from before the final mission.
Complete the final mission (You Gotta Know When to Get Off, gold).
After the credits you return to free-roam Leonida; everything for 100% is still available.

roadmap.title: After the story — the 100% checklist
items: Open the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (35 requirements).
Finish the full-completion items: 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 42 Shooting Range golds, 14 drone-race wins, Bret's full questline.
Reach the lenient thresholds: 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditation spots.
Earn A Long Road (gold) when the checklist hits 100%.

roadmap.title: Cleanup — strands and odd jobs
items: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands (Strangers & Freaks, silver).
Complete the side-character finales: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone.
Hunt Bret's unique animal (Fair Game) and max both characters' Strength at the gym (Personal Best).

Mop up the one-offs: the VCIA jet (Catch Me If You Can), the Rhino tank (Challenging Tank), 5 kills in one Combat Focus (Gunslinger), all 52 areas (The Goodtime State), $100,000 spent (Treat Yo Self).
Check the five unconfirmed trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) against the latest guides.
Vice Got a Price! (platinum) pops with the last trophy.
